title: quercus falcata var. triloba
intro: Quercus falcata var. triloba, commonly known as the Southern Live Oak or Laurel Oak, is a variety of the white oak tree that is native to the southeastern United States. The health benefits of Quercus falcata var. triloba include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The plant has therapeutic actions as a vasodilator and anti-inflammatory agent, which can be used to treat conditions such as high blood pressure and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Quercus falcata var. triloba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
